factor_policy: Five raw factor x coordinates are exact normal-basis masks of Hamming weight 3 or 4; each x has one free rational lift-sign bit. All five masks are pinned only in the planted positive control.
point_arithmetic: For nonzero x, compute x inverse by an addition chain for x^(2^83-2), derive y=x*(half_trace(x+x^-2)+sign), and require the curve equation. Add all five points with deterministic affine formulas, requiring distinct x at each successive addition. Constrain the final raw point to one exact public cofactor-four target fiber. This is the regular locus only; identity and equal-x steps are omitted and must be covered by a later complete solver.
run_order: Regenerate the frozen fixture under the checked Sage launcher and verify identical public SHA-256; run small-field SAT/group controls; encode and solve one pinned-factor planted branch on the exact raw sum; independently replay a found model in installed Sage; only then try unpinned planted fibers and the frozen ordinary target, with every failure retained.
claim_boundary: Regular-locus deterministic-point-circuit positive control only. No unpinned witness, ordinary-query yield, factor-log matrix, single-target DLP, rho pair, or speedup can be inferred from a pinned result.
